Renamed to red_m_free_mirror for inclusion ; in crispred pipeline. ; FUNCTION red_m_free_mirror, R, dd, DEGREE=deg IF keyword_set(deg) THEN d = dd*!dtor ELSE d = dd r1 = 2*sqrt(R) Mae = 0.5*[[1+R, 1-R, 0.0, 0.0], $ [1-R, 1+R, 0.0, 0.0], $ [0.0, 0.0, -r1*cos(d), -r1*sin(d)], $ [0.0, 0.0, r1*sin(d), -r1*cos(d)]] return, Mae END
